consumer: The dialogue/mission condition evaluator at condition.cpp::conditional_t::set_has_item (the u_has_item/npc_has_item lambda), which EVALUATES the yes/no 'does the actor have item X' by returning actor->charges_of(item_id) > 0 || actor->has_amount(item_id, 1).
scope: only the character actor's own carried items (wielded/worn/inventory as charges_of/has_amount traverse them, with gun/magazine contents gated) — NOT items merely reachable nearby
decisive_source: src/condition.cpp::conditional_t::set_has_item — its body computes the engine's own has-item predicate over the alpha/beta player actor via charges_of/has_amount, the exact value a mission or dialogue check consumes.
divergence: Item X sits in a crate on an adjacent tile (or inside a carried gun/magazine, whose contents visit_internal deliberately gates): the real u_has_item predicate returns false, but an answer re-derived over reachable-nearby inventory or a naive contents-walk returns true, exposing the wrong reach.
